title: Business development specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (Linked In, sector-specific networks).
Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients’ engineering challenges.
Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2 B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.). Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1 M).
Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
Proficiency in CRM tools
Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

Advanced to fluent English.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.

title: Senior full stack developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.
Nice to have:
Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.
Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation .

Aqui, você terá a chance de trabalhar com um time de alto nível atendendo clientes globais, construindo conexões valiosas e evoluindo suas habilidades e competências. Oferecemos programas de treinamento focados no seu crescimento e qualificação, programas de desenvolvimento & performance e um ambiente que promove a excelência e aprendizado. Além do trabalho, cuidamos do seu bem-estar, garantindo um ambiente acolhedor, cultivando a riqueza das relações interpessoais.

- Gerir todas as rotinas contábeis da área, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e a qualidade das entregas;

- Representar a área contábil em reuniões comerciais e estratégicas, contribuindo para o crescimento da base de clientes e a ampliação dos serviços prestados;
- Liderar e desenvolver a equipe contábil (supervisores, analistas e assistentes), promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e focado em resultados;
- Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área, propondo melhorias contínuas em processos, sistemas e atendimento;
- Atuar junto à diretoria na definição de estratégias para o crescimento da área, retenção de clientes e padronização de rotinas;
- Garantir o alinhamento da equipe às políticas internas, atualizações legais e boas práticas contábeis, comerciais e de gestão.

Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
Possuir CRC Ativo;

Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades Contábeis;
Conhecimento com Gestão de equipes;

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.
Ei Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior – Produção e Sustentação , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq
- O que procuramos?
Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!
- O que você deve ter?
Habilidades Principais: Suporte à Produção Sênior (N2/N3) em sistemas críticos, com atuação em ambientes financeiros, RTB (Real Time Banking) e SCB, realizando análise e resolução de incidentes de alta complexidade. Garantia de alta disponibilidade, estabilidade e performance , atuando em ambientes de missão crítica, alto volume transacional e baixa latência, com condução de análises de causa raiz e melhorias contínuas. Atuação técnica em aplicações. NET (C#) , incluindo sustentação, troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance de aplicações e bancos de dados. Experiência sólida em AWS (EC2, ECS/EKS, Cloud Watch, S3, IAM) e mensageria , com destaque para Rabbit MQ. Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados , tanto relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, Postgre SQL) quanto não relacionais (Mongo DB, Redis), incluindo estratégias de cache e performance.
Perfil analítico e proativo , com vivência em ambientes financeiros, atuação em incidentes críticos, war room, gestão de SLA e práticas como ITIL, SRE, Dev Ops e ferramentas de observabilidade (APM, métricas e alertas).
Modelo de trabalho: Hibrido 3x na semana na região de Bota Fogo - RJ

Mais do que um plano de carreira !
A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:
Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!
Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.
Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.
- E os benefícios?
Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!
- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?
Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é: Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, Versa Max, Quick Panel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.
Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

A Baggio e Carvalho Engenharia é uma empresa de médio porte, especializada em gestão e execução de obras comerciais e residenciais desde 1986. A empresa vem em um ritmo de crescimento interessante nos últimos anos e está buscando pessoas para somar e crescer com ela.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) de Engenharia Civil para atuar junto à equipe técnica, apoiando o(a) engenheiro(a) responsável em diversas frentes do dia a dia da obra. Procuramos alguém dinâmico(a), criativo(a) e com vontade de aprender, que goste de colocar a mão na massa e se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, onde o aprendizado é constante.

. Apoiar o(a) engenheiro(a) da obra no acompanhamento das atividades de campo;
. Realizar levantamentos de quantitativos e auxiliar na validação de escopo de fornecedores;
. Participar de reuniões com cliente, arquiteto e gerenciadora;
. Apoiar o controle de medições e acompanhamento físico e financeiro da obra;
. Auxiliar na leitura e compatibilização de projetos;
. Contribuir com a organização de documentos e registros técnicos no drive da obra;
. Participar ativamente das rotinas de planejamento e execução, aprendendo sobre as etapas e processos construtivos.
Pré-requisitos:
. Estar cursando a partir do 7º período de Engenharia Civil;
. Conhecimento em Excel e Auto CAD (projetos 2 D);
. Leitura e interpretação de projetos estruturais;
Desejável:
. Curso técnico em edificações.
Outras informações:
. Carga horária: 30h semanais (segunda a sexta-feira);

. Local: Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro.

title: Profissional back end .net/aws - sr
description:
Código da vaga: 55675
Sobre a BRQ Digital
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.
Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.
BRQ WAY
No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!
É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.
Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.
Ei Profissional Back End. Net/Aws - SR , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq
- O que procuramos?
Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!
- O que você deve ter?
Habilidades Principais:
Profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento back-end. Net com sólida vivência em ambientes escaláveis (milhões de transações/requisições mensais) e arquitetura baseada em microsserviços e mensageria (Rabbit MQ ou Kafka).
Principais responsabilidades: Projetar, implementar e manter soluções distribuídas; desenvolver integrações assíncronas; otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.); e garantir performance, segurança e resiliência em sistemas de alta disponibilidade.
Requisitos obrigatórios: Experiência prática com AWS, Rabbit MQ (ou mensageria similar), arquitetura de microsserviços, bancos relacionais (SQL Server, My SQL) e No SQL (Mongo DB). Desejável experiência com CI/CD, Git e metodologias ágeis.
Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes), vivência com outras clouds (Azure, GCP) e experiência comprovada com sistemas de alta performance e escalabilidade.
Modelo de trabalho: Vaga presencial na região de Botafogo – RJ.
- O que temos pra te oferecer?
Mais do que um plano de carreira !
A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:
Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!
Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.
Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.
- E os benefícios?
Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!
- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?
Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions
Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Platform engineer (aws)
description:
About you
You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.
You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer , Dev Ops Engineer , or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement . Deep expertise in AWS , especially working with services like ECS , IAM , and supporting microservices architectures. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning. Hands-on experience with Git Hub , Git Hub Actions , and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments. Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python , Bash , or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation. Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage . Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (Paa S) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows. Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning. Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic , such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs. Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .
You will be accountable for the following responsibilities: Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently. Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git Hub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services. Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale. Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs. Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation. Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams. Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation. Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.
Additional Information
Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.
Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!
We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.
Some of our perks and benefits:
Celebrations
Special discounts*
Entertainment area*
Modern Work Spaces*
Great work environment
Private medical insurance*

title: Financial controller
description:

Prepare monthly financial reporting
Lead month-end closing procedures

Accurate OPEX recharges
P& L review
Profit split

Strong experience in auditing small and mid-sized businesses or as a Financial Controller.
Strong knowledge of local Brazilian taxes and reporting requirements.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
Strong ability to maintain a high-level overview while being hands-on and detail-oriented
Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail
Team player with strong collaboration skills
Fluent in English and Spanish

title: Collection professional - consultor sênior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Descrição do perfil Responsável por assegurar o desenvolvimento e a gestão das infraestruturas técnicas necessárias para as atividades de cobrança, controlando o processo de cobrança, analisando periodicamente as contas para identificar aquelas que podem requerer procedimentos de cobrança especiais e atuando também nos processos de governança que envolvem a cadeia de cobrança.
Principais atividades
Controlar todos os processos da cadeia de Cobrança, com objetivo de garantir a aderência as regras de negócio implementadas e o monitoramento fim a fim de todas as etapas da régua de cobrança;
Gerenciar as bases faturadas Vs. Ações de cobrança, mapeando os principais ofensores/oportunidades garantindo a qualidade;
Realizar auditorias sobre todas as ações da régua de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar os principais ofensores em toda cadeia de cobrança e assim atuar junto a TI na solução das inconsistências;
Controlar o processo de No Dunning (isenção de cobrança), com o objetivo de garantir a governança desta carteira e seus respectivos motivos, por meio de relatórios e processos de auditoria;

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.

Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as

description:

title: Senior backend (typescript) engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.We’re looking for aSenior Backend (Typescript) Engineerto join on an initial 12-month B2 B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market –how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality :At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving :We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDev Ops, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.

title: Anti-money laundering manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings withCOAFor relevant authorities.
Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.
• Opportunities to work outside Brazil
• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.What do we offer?TCS Benefits – Brazil:
Health insurance
Dental Plan
Life insurance
Transportation vouchers
Meal/Food Voucher
Childcare assistance
Gympass
TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
Partnership with SESC
Reimbursement of Certifications
Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
International experience opportunity
Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career PlatformAt TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!#BuildingonbeliefID:

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Client services, interpretation (language services | research | due diligence | remote)
description:
About Us
Cadence ( ) is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.Key Responsibilities
You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen onour careers page.You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.The JobYou will manage multiple projects per day.Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).Here’s how you will interact with a project:Scoping
You will speak with clients via email, phone, or We Chat about their needs
You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project
Matchmaking
Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction
Executing
You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied
Key RequirementsBachelor’s degree in a related field
Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plusWorking Hours & LocationThis is afully-remote rolewhere you can work from home ( WFH )
You will work eitherAPAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - Lat Am applicants will work AMER hours)
Weekends and overnights shifts are availablewith a commensurate increase in compensation.Compensation & Benefits
Salary commensurate with experience
Paid time off
Health insurance
Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: International buyer
description:
General Description
The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Sales executive - shipyards & shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners
Department: Sales
Role Summary
The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M& O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.
The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M& O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Product & Solution Representation
Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards. Business Development
Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
Expand M& O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction. Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight
Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions. Sales Strategy & Reporting
Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M& O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.
Skills and Competencies B2 B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales. Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams. Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance. Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes. Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.
Experience Requirements 2 to 5 years of experience in B2 B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors. Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers . Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects. Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

title: Estagiário de customer support
description:
Sobre a DTX
A DTX é uma empresa líder na indústria aeroespacial. Conhecida por sua abordagem inovadora e tecnologia de ponta, a empresa é especializada no design, fabricação e manutenção de trens de pouso. Com um forte foco em qualidade e segurança, estabelecemos-nos como um parceiro confiável para muitas das principais companhias aéreas e organizações militares em todo o mundo. Estamos comprometidos com a melhoria contínua e a sustentabilidade, investindo pesadamente em pesquisa e desenvolvimento para impulsionar a indústria.

Estamos buscando novos estagiários para compor nosso time de suporte ao cliente.
O foco deste programa de estágio é a formação de especialistas em atendimento ao cliente em unidades técnicas de MRO de trem de pouso.
O estagiário irá passar por todas as áreas do setor em esquema de " job rotation " para que possa aprender sobre o processo de atendimento ao cliente "end-to-end" .
O estagiário de suporte ao cliente irá ajudar nossa equipe de atendimento ao cliente a garantir operações tranquilas e promover relacionamentos positivos com nossos clientes. Este estágio proporcionará uma valiosa experiência prática na indústria aeroespacial de MRO, particularmente na área de sistemas de trem de pouso. O estagiário apoiará as atividades diárias de atendimento ao cliente, ajudará na resolução de dúvidas dos clientes e contribuirá para o processo geral de satisfação do cliente.
Principais responsabilidades:
Auxiliar na resposta às perguntas dos clientes por telefone, e-mail ou chat, fornecendo informações relacionadas aos serviços de MRO do trem de pouso.
Coordenar com equipes internas, incluindo engenharia, operações e logística, para garantir a resolução oportuna das solicitações dos clientes.
Ajudar a manter registros precisos do cliente, garantindo que todas as interações sejam documentadas no sistema de CRM.
Apoiar na elaboração de cotações, cronogramas de serviços e relatórios para clientes.
Auxiliar no rastreamento e atualização dos pedidos dos clientes, garantindo a entrega pontual dos serviços.
Trabalhar com a equipe de suporte ao cliente para garantir altos níveis de satisfação do cliente e acompanhar os problemas de serviço.
Participar de pesquisas de feedback do cliente e contribua para melhorar os processos de atendimento.
Ajudar em quaisquer tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao suporte ao cliente e entrada de dados.
Auxiliar na resolução de quaisquer problemas operacionais, incluindo atrasos ou discrepâncias de serviço, sob supervisão.
Competências a serem adquiridas:
Compreensão dos sistemas de trem de pouso:
Conhecimento básico dos componentes e funções dos sistemas de trem de pouso em aeronaves.
Familiaridade com práticas comuns de manutenção de trem de pouso, procedimentos de reparo e cronogramas de revisão.
Entrada de dados e gerenciamento de banco de dados:
Desenvolver habilidades na inserção e gerenciamento de grandes quantidades de dados técnicos, como solicitações de atendimento ao cliente, especificações de peças e relatórios de serviço.
Aprender a organizar e recuperar dados de forma eficiente para relatórios e análises.
Ferramentas de cotação e estimativa:
Ganhar exposição às ferramentas e processos usados para preparar cotações e estimativas de serviços, incluindo a compreensão de modelos de preços com base em custos de peças e horas de mão de obra.
Saber como ajudar na geração de estimativas de custos para reparos e revisões de trem de pouso.
Solução de problemas com problemas técnicos:
Desenvolver habilidades na identificação e análise de problemas técnicos relatados pelos clientes, como problemas com o desempenho do trem de pouso.
Aprender a coordenar com engenheiros e equipes técnicas para solucionar problemas e resolver problemas com eficiência.
Requisitos e informações da vaga:
O candidato deve obrigatoriamente estar cursando nível superior em disciplina relevante.
A instituição de ensino deve fornecer à empresa um modelo de contrato de estágio.
Duração de 12 meses.
O candidato precisa ter disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma 100% presencial na área industrial do Aeroporto do Galeão - RJ.
Para essa vaga o inglês avançado ou fluente é obrigatório.

title: Analista de validação de processo
description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.
2. Desenvolver e executar protocolos de validação de limpeza para assegurar a remoção eficaz de resíduos e evitar a contaminação cruzada. Determinar os limites de aceitação de acordo com os requisitos de boas práticas de fabricação (GMP).
3. Planejar e conduzir validações de filtração esterilizante, incluindo testes de integridade, adsorção e retenção bacteriana para garantir a eficácia dos filtros utilizados nos processos de esterilização.
4. Realizar estudos de tempo de espera (holding time) para determinar e validar os tempos máximos permitidos entre as etapas críticas de produção, garantindo a manutenção da qualidade e esterilidade dos produtos.
5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.
6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.
7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.
9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.
10. Participação da elaboração de URS (User Requirements Specification) para definição de novos projetos ou alteração de projetos já existentes.
